cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need light to work. It's just faulty wiring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel that. Ask the house about overtime; we need its agreement before booking your evening shifts.

mechanism: A manages lighting and yields practical workspace needs while pushing B to replace electrical repair with negotiation with the house.
confusable: Unlike merely entertaining an impossible theory alongside ordinary repair, A asks B to cancel the remaining electrician plan.
comparison: House lighting and work shifts differ from searching under a cushion for invisible keys.
